eyebrow: Running it: three landing page designs
code:
a = rng.normal(50, 12, 60).round(2)
b = rng.normal(54, 12, 60).round(2)
c = rng.normal(60, 12, 60).round(2)
# means: 50.56, 53.61, 58.18

f, p = stats.f_oneway(a, b, c)
print(round(f,3), round(p,4))   # 7.359  0.0009
caption: Reject the null that all three means are equal.

eyebrow: Behind the scenes: sums of squares, by hand
code:
ssb = sum(len(g) * (g.mean()-grand)**2 for g in groups)   # 1764.4
ssw = sum(((g - g.mean())**2).sum() for g in groups)      # 21217.6

F = (ssb/(3-1)) / (ssw/(180-3))   # ~7.36 -- matches scipy
caption: Between-group sum of squares over within-group, each scaled by its degrees of freedom.

eyebrow: Eta squared: how much does group explain?
caption: Only ~7.7% of total variation -- group matters, but most variance is individual differences.

code:
res = stats.tukey_hsd(a, b, c)
# A vs B: 0.2807
# A vs C: 0.0006  <- clearly different
# B vs C: 0.0606
caption: B sits in between, indistinguishable from either neighbor -- "not significant" != "the same".
